query: How should we combine module completion, core task completion, SMART goal initiation, 30-day follow-through, and 3-month maintenance into one reproducible composite engagement metric?

response.query: How should we combine module completion, core task completion, SMART goal initiation, 30-day follow-through, and 3-month maintenance into one reproducible composite engagement metric?
response.answer: Combine module completion, core task completion, SMART goal initiation, 30-day follow-through, and 3-month maintenance into a composite metric by averaging their respective completion rates. This metric will track overall engagement and progress.
